name: Acceptance suite-3 test 95 - mixed actions require per-action resource evaluation
note: IAM-1006 (F2): a statement mixing iam:ListRoles (a required-wildcard enumeration action with NO resource-level scoping) with iam:PassRole (where a wildcard resource is dangerous and remediable) on Resource '*'. The WILDCARD-RESOURCE finding fires because of the dangerous sibling, but its remediable action list must contain ONLY iam:PassRole - presenting iam:ListRoles with impossible 'scope the ARN' remediation is exactly what test 92 / requirement #3 forbid. Per-action, not one resource-scope conclusion for the whole statement.
